temples.name: SHREE SHYAM MANDIR ALAMBAZAR
temples.description: Shree Shyam Mandir Alambazar is a prominent Khatu Shyam Ji temple in North Kolkata, West Bengal, popularly known among devotees as “Kolkata ka Khatu Dham”. Dedicated to Shri Khatu Shyam Ji, it is one of the renowned Shyam Mandirs in Eastern India and an important spiritual destination for devotees. The temple attracts devotees for darshan, bhajan, kirtan and aarti and is a popular Shyam Mandir in Kolkata.
